title: High-stress regime periods
instructions: Return ret, vol and p_stress for dates where the stress-regime probability is >= {prob}, ordered from most stressed to least.
hint: Work inside out. Mark dates with stress-regime probability at least the threshold.

explanation.meaning: Mark dates with stress-regime probability at least the threshold.
Retain the three relevant diagnostics.
Show strongest stress evidence first.

title: Regime entropy indicator
instructions: Compute binary probability entropy -p*log(p)-(1-p)*log(1-p) as a Series for each date.
hint: Work inside out. Vectorize the log calculation over every date.

explanation.meaning: Vectorize the log calculation over every date.
Combine weighted uncertainty contributions for both regimes; larger entropy means a less decisive posterior.

title: Volatility-scaled exposure
instructions: Return a Series of lagged signal clipped to [-1,1], divided by previous-day volatility, and then clipped to [-{cap}, {cap}].
hint: Work inside out. Only previous-date information is available for today’s weight.

explanation.meaning: Only previous-date information is available for today’s weight.
Bound the directional conviction before scaling.
Apply inverse-risk scaling followed by a leverage limit.

title: Regime classification changes
instructions: Return a Boolean Series identifying dates where the binary stress classification (p_stress > 0.5) changed versus the prior date.
hint: Work inside out. Create one Boolean regime state per date.

explanation.meaning: Create one Boolean regime state per date.
Align yesterday’s classification with today’s date.
Mark changes; first row is True because previous state is missing.

title: Out-of-sample forecast residuals
instructions: Return realized-minus-forecast errors only on dates with absolute error strictly above {threshold}.
hint: Work inside out. Construct the error series date by date with aligned indices.

explanation.meaning: Construct the error series date by date with aligned indices.
Mark unusually large misses by their magnitude, regardless of positive or negative sign.
Keep only those dates while preserving each error sign.

title: Cumulative active return
instructions: Return compounded cumulative performance of the strategy minus compounded cumulative benchmark performance at each date.
hint: Work inside out. Construct one wealth curve for the strategy and another for the benchmark.

explanation.meaning: Construct one wealth curve for the strategy and another for the benchmark.
Return the difference in cumulative total-return factors, not a cumulative sum of daily excess returns.

title: Portfolio holdings matrix
instructions: Return daily portfolio weight as a matrix of dates × tickers, with ticker columns ordered AAPL, JPM, MSFT, NVDA.
hint: Work inside out. Reshape long holdings into a 2D weight matrix: one observation per (date,ticker).

explanation.meaning: Reshape long holdings into a 2D weight matrix: one observation per (date,ticker).
Fix ticker ordering for matrix multiplication and reporting.

title: Daily weighted portfolio return
instructions: Compute the cross-sectional weighted portfolio return per date using each asset weight × daily return. Return a date-indexed Series.
hint: Work inside out. Calculate each asset contribution within its date.

explanation.meaning: Calculate each asset contribution within its date.
Sum contributions to get one portfolio return per date. The weights in this dataset approximately sum to one per date.

title: Portfolio beta exposure
instructions: For each date, calculate total portfolio beta as sum(weight × beta), returning a Series.
hint: Work inside out. Translate holdings weights and individual beta values into contributions.

explanation.meaning: Translate holdings weights and individual beta values into contributions.
Aggregate one portfolio-level beta for each rebalance date.

title: One-way turnover by date
instructions: Pivot holdings to dates × tickers, difference consecutive weight vectors, take absolute values, sum across tickers and divide by two. Return a date-indexed Series.
hint: Work inside out. Place holdings into a consistent date-by-ticker matrix; alignment is by ticker label.

explanation.meaning: Place holdings into a consistent date-by-ticker matrix; alignment is by ticker label.
Compute absolute changes in each asset weight from the prior rebalance.
Aggregate rebalancing turnover across assets. The first row evaluates to zero under pandas sum defaults.

title: Portfolio HHI
instructions: For each date, compute portfolio concentration as sum of squared asset weights; return a Series.
hint: Work inside out. Square each asset weight independently.

explanation.meaning: Square each asset weight independently.
Sum squared weights across the date’s holdings to obtain Herfindahl concentration.

title: Rank names by risk contribution proxy
instructions: Keep the top two tickers per date ranked by absolute weight × beta, returning date, ticker and a new risk_proxy column.
hint: Work inside out. Define a simple absolute beta-exposure proxy for each holding.

explanation.meaning: Define a simple absolute beta-exposure proxy for each holding.
Place largest exposures first within each date.
Take two names per date rather than two overall.
Display only date, asset and exposure.
